name: Red brick arch, white roses 002
glow_concept: keystone carved with a softly glowing name
prompt: a freestanding stone garden arch swallowed by climbing vines and hanging blossom, red brick arch, white roses, large, well above head height of a person, self-emissive at night, softly radiating light: keystone carved with a softly glowing name

placement.note: ONE SCENERY PIXEL IS ONE PLAYER PIXEL. world_px_height IS the art's own alpha bbox height, so scenery is placed into the world at 1:1 exactly as the avatar is (setScale(1)) and the two share one pixel grid. The CAMERA still zooms the whole scene — that is uniform and correct; what must never happen is scenery being resampled on its own, against the player. world_height_m is what the art reads as beside a 87px character; declared_height_m is what it was once declared to be, and a gap between them means the ART is the wrong size.

motion.description: This is the same picture in every frame. ONLY the light of the small sign at the top of the arch brightens a little and returns. Nothing in the picture may change size, shape or position. The last frame must return to exactly how the first frame looks, so the loop joins. Nothing may become darker than it is in the first frame. Everything else is frozen and pixel-for-pixel identical. Do not redraw anything else, and do not add or remove anything.
